create_cuda_rt_library: create a CudaRTLibrary instance to wrap the cudart shared library for CUDA device operations
build_cuda_memory_allocation: build cuda memory allocation using cudaMalloc and cudaFree through the CudaRTLibrary wrapper
test_cuda_device_synchronization: test cuda device synchronization by calling cudaDeviceSynchronize and cudaDeviceReset methods
run_cuda_memory_copy: run cuda memory copy between device and host buffers using cudaMemcpy on the CudaRTLibrary instance
review_cuda_ipc_handle: review cuda IPC memory handle creation and opening via cudaIpcGetMemHandle and cudaIpcOpenMemHandle
